Turning Point: Fall of Liberty came out in 2008 for PS3, Xbox 360, and PC. It is a FPS. It was developed by Spark Unlimited and published by Codemasters. I got the game new on Amazon for $10 but it runs for an average price of $5-10 used at most places.

Story: Turning Point(TP) takes place during WW2 with an alternate history where Winston Church Hill dies in 1931, which lets Germany take over England and the rest of Europe with no issues. The game starts off with you as an average New Yorker working on a building as Germany invades America. When this happens your character is forced to fight to try and get out of New York and join the resistance. With the story you'll fight through New York, Washington D.C. and London. The story itself is interesting with the alternate history. Unfortunately, that's all this game has to offer.

Gameplay: The gameplay is just awful. The controls don't feel great, movement feels very stiff. Even "turning" is hard in this game, it's one of the worse things about it. Most of my deaths came from trying to turn around when an enemy got stuck behind me. With aiming you'll have to aim slowly since it's hard to do with the bad controls. I just ended up spinning around with a machine gun or shotgunning people at point blank to kill them. You don't have a melee in this game but an action button, when you're close up on an enemy press your action button and a cut scene takes place which takes about 5 seconds to complete and during the time you can be shot and killed. Also with the action button you have to be at just the right angle otherwise nothing happens, except they get stuck behind you and kill you. There is a little mini game where you have to wire a bomb onto things. It's cool the first time but it quickly becomes repetitive. This is also another bullet storm game, where your enemies have perfect aim while the horrible controls hinder you.

Overall the game might be worth a cheap playthrough for the alternate history. However, the game is only about 4-5hrs long for the single player campaign. I never checked to see if the online was still working, though I doubt it is. For the story, gameplay and price I give Turning point a 4/10. When I got to the end I was just glad to be done. Thank you for reading.
